##### **Autoclave Leaching - the heart of the plant** - 3 HPAL autoclaves operate at 260°C - Flash steam is used to heat the incoming slurry however a novel innovation is employed to recover any excess steam to produce medium pressure steam for distribution across site - The traditional heater and flash vessels have been combined in a single vessel for the first time - known as a fleater. - In Q1 2013, the autoclave operation achieved design rates (195 dtph) for the first time after almost 2 years of steady improvement. - Next challenge is 3 autoclave operation **22** ##### **Counter-Current Decantation** Leached

##### **Pulse Column Rebuild Project** - During the refinery start-up in April 2010 one of the SX-1 columns collapsed after the internals failed. - Over the next two years all 21 pulsed columns completely rebuilt with improved the mechanical strength, process performance and corrosion. - The performance of the rebuilt columns (recommissioned at the end of 2012) - has met expectations and allowed the ramp-up of the refinery to start again after a 2 year break. - During the rebuild project the plant was converted to produce an intermediate nickel-cobalt hydroxide product.
